stories.title: Les Leyne: Inked-up new deputy premier proves anything is possible
stories.summary: In B.C.’s history of parliamentary government, it’s unlikely anyone has faced a steeper climb from regular citizen to the top tier of elected officialdom than Claire Rattée.

stories.title: Young philanthropist honoured for raising thousands through lemonade stand
stories.summary: Anders Yee, who has raised more than $8,500 for the Victoria Hospitals Foundation, was one of several people honoured at a gala celebration this week.

stories.title: Woman's death prompts calls to reopen Port Hardy ER overnight
stories.summary: A woman showed up at Port Hardy’s emergency room just after it had closed on Thursday evening. Despite treatment, she did not survive.

stories.title: Goldeneyes to close out PWHL training camp at Shawnigan Lake School
stories.summary: Vancouver’s entry in the Professional Women’s Hockey League will finish training at Shawnigan Lake School Nov. 28-30.

stories.title: DeBrusk lifts resilient Canucks over Wild with shootout winner
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — Jake DeBrusk scored in a shootout as the Vancouver Canucks defeated the league-leading Minnesota Wild 4-3 in an NHL game Saturday night.

stories.title: Noah Cates scores late, Flyers hold on for 4-3 win over Canadiens
stories.summary: MONTREAL — Noah Cates scored the winner with 31 seconds left in regulation as the Philadelphia Flyers held on to beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-3 after blowing a two-goal lead Saturday night.

stories.title: Jets' Scheifele touched by fans' reaction to record-setting goal
stories.summary: WINNIPEG — The often-stoic Mark Scheifele admitted the crowd’s enthusiastic reaction to his record-setting goal left a big impression on him.

stories.title: 'We should be embarrassed': Leafs squander another lead, winless run extends to nine
stories.summary: TORONTO — Jim Hiller was behind the bench with his Maple Leafs desperately hanging onto a one-goal lead. The crowd at Scotiabank Arena had urged their team on all night in hopes of ending an ugly streak.

stories.title: Cousins makes an impact on winning return to Senators' lineup
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Nick Cousins doesn’t often generate headlines but his impact is immeasurable.

stories.title: NHL roundup: Hurricanes surge past Oilers for wild 7-4 victory
stories.summary: RALEIGH, N.C. (AP) — Andrei Svechnikov scored two goals and Sebastian Aho had a goal and two assists to lead the Carolina Hurricanes to a 7-4 win over the Edmonton Oilers on Saturday.

stories.title: Jacobs' foursome advances to final at GSOC National in Sydney
stories.summary: SYDNEY — Brad Jacobs and his Calgary squad scored a deuce in the sixth end and stole two more in the seventh en route to a 7-3 victory over Oskar Eriksson of Sweden in the men's semifinals of the Grand Slam of Curling National event on Saturday night
